A giant old friendly sage CRT monitor fills upper central area, centered at x50% y35%. Its outer case spans roughly x13% to87%, y15% to48%. The screen displays ONLY two very simple dark dot eyes and a small gentle curved smile; otherwise entirely blank pale green. No text, numbers, symbols, menus or complicated face.
Underneath is an old desk, a single quiet paper journal lying flat and one closed desk drawer. Keep ALL OF THE BOTTOM HALF visually calm, low detail and low contrast, with broad areas of softly sunlit worn wood and plain painted cabinetry, suitable for an in-game conversation and journal overlay. Room still coherent, no large distracting foreground clutter. The monitor is the clear focal point, welcoming and humble.
No visible people or body parts. No UI, readable writing, letters, titles, logos, watermark, borders, or white paper margins. Do not paint dialogue panels. Maintain warm handmade watercolor grain across the full image.
